Four pairings fall below AA UI on one ground. forest on void is 1.38:1 — effectively invisible. copper, confirm and hazard fall short on paper. The palette is locked (§29), so these are usage constraints, not defects: colour is never the only carrier of meaning. A status carries a label, a metric carries a unit. See docs/DESIGN-USAGE-RULES.md.

Risk categories — all ten, reconciled

Six of the ten registry categories rendered grey until 31 Jul 2026, which makes a risk register unscannable — the one thing a register exists to be. Four design-only names were mapped onto their registry synonyms, two categories were given new colours, and construction and reputation were dropped because the registry does not track them.

Type scale — 13 roles

Structural sizes land on the 4px grid. Reading sizes (17 / 15 / 13 / 11) are deliberately odd, because reading sizes are optical rather than geometric — rounding 15 to 16 to satisfy a grid trades legibility for tidiness. Type does not change with density; only spacing does, so a figure is the same size in every mode and two screenshots of one table stay comparable.

BreakpointMinColsGutterMarginNote
compact0 41616 Phone. Tables become stacked cards.
medium768 82432 Tablet.
wide1180 122448 Default desktop.
ultra1680 1232auto Trading-desk width. Container centres at max width.
If the route starts with (capital) or (admin), design desktop-first; otherwise design phone-parity. A capital allocation terminal and a member checking whether they were paid are different products, and one blanket answer would have misdesigned one of them.

Charts

There is no chart palette. A series is coloured by what it measures, from the metric grammar — otherwise the same quantity is copper in a table and blue in the chart beside it. A forecast segment is dashed and electric, never colour alone. A truncated y-axis is barred on financial data: an axis that does not start at zero makes a 2% move look like a collapse.
ChartFor
Waterfall BarThe six distribution stages
NAV Over TimeValuation history per property or vehicle
IRR CurveCash flows and return
Allocation BarCapital table by holder
Reserve GaugeBalance against floor
SparklineInline trend in a table row

Atoms & molecules

RefNameTier
A-01Tag Pill atom
A-03Mono Input Field atom
A-10Confidence Tag atom
A-11Health Score Ring atom
M-04The Piston molecule
M-06Recovery Strip molecule
M-16Ledger Row molecule
The Piston is a bar. A ring implies a duration that loops; this control fires exactly once per commitment. Filling text is illegible during a three-second hold. Three tick marks at 25/50/75% give the linear fill legible progress — without them a 3000ms fill reads as an undifferentiated blur. Under reduced motion it becomes a static countdown numeral and keeps its full 3000ms.

Reserve Gaugefour bands against the floor≥120 · 110-119 · 100-109 · <100
Waterfall Barsix stages in fixed order, shortfall markedstage · amount · shortfall
Hold-to-Commit3s hold before a capital-moving actionidle → engaged → sealed → locked
Zero radius everywhere. No drop shadows — depth comes from hairlines. Circles only for status LEDs and the Trinity Lens. Every animation respects prefers-reduced-motion, including this page.
